final: WITH city_counts AS (SELECT ci.city_id, ci.city, COUNT(a.address_id) AS address_count FROM city ci JOIN address a ON a.city_id = ci.city_id GROUP BY ci.city_id, ci.city) SELECT city_id, city, address_count, address_count * 1.0 / AVG(address_count) OVER () AS relative_to_average, address_count * 1.0 / SUM(address_count) OVER () AS share_of_all_addresses FROM city_counts ORDER BY share_of_all_addresses DESC LIMIT 10
